.

,

,

,

Custom extensions
(
keycloak-extensions/
)
Extension
What it does
accept-reservation-token
Custom action token for magic links: validates the JWT, blocks a
different logged-in user, validates the nonce with the backend, creates
the session and redirects. Exposes the token-minting REST endpoint with
a rate limiter
audit-event-listener
Sends LOGIN and LOGOUT events (and errors) to the backend
/api/v1/internal/audit/keycloak-event
default-role-restriction
Self-signup users keep
default-roles-customer
;
admin-created users have defaults stripped
multi-org-policy
Only account-manager roles may belong to more than one
organization
Build with
keycloak-extensions/build.sh
; images from
keycloak/Dockerfile
and
keycloak/Dockerfile-local
.
Themes
The NVIDIA theme lives in
keycloak/themes/nvidia/
(login, account, admin, email). The login theme extends
keycloak.v2
and adds organization-type registration fields
(enterprise, government, sme_msme, startup).
Organizations
Keycloak Organizations model NCP and customer companies.
NCP organization names come from the Salesforce account name; one
organization per Salesforce account.
The
organization
JWT claim carries the user’s
organization; the backend stores matching organization records.
Local Keycloak
Admin console:
http://localhost:8080/admin
, realm
customer
.
Management/health port: host 9001.
Admin credentials are generated into
local-setup/.onboarding/credentials.json
.
